comment:
The approaches to financing (section 4.6.3.) includes budget lines, blended arrangements, scheme contributions, private hosting, pooled programme investments; but it does not specifically mention MDB instruments such as sovereign lending, results-based lending, or policy-based operations.  

Regional and shared financing is also not addressed, which may apply to small island states where regional public foods financing and shared hosting may be the most affordable route.
